lines.beaver: 요즘 얼굴이 많이 피곤해 보여요. 무슨 일 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: You look really tired lately. Is something wrong?
lines.beaver_roman: yojeum eolguri mani pigonhae boyeoyo. museun il isseoyo?
lines.learner: 네, 요즘 마음에 여유가 하나도 없어요.
lines.en: Yes, I have no peace of mind these days.
lines.roman: ne, yojeum maeume yeoyuga hanado eopseoyo.

lines.beaver: 일이 많이 바빠요? 잠은 잘 자요?
lines.beaver_en: Are you very busy with work? Do you sleep well?
lines.beaver_roman: iri mani bappayo? jameun jal jayo?
lines.learner: 아니요, 정신이 없어서 잠도 잘 못 자요.
lines.en: No, my mind is so frazzled I can't sleep well.
lines.roman: aniyo, jeongsini eopseoseo jamdo jal mot jayo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 짧게라도 쉬어 보세요. 산책은 어때요?
lines.beaver_en: Then try resting, even briefly. How about a walk?
lines.beaver_roman: geureom jjalgerado swieo boseyo. sanchaegeun eottaeyo?
lines.en: A walk? Should I wander around the neighborhood?

lines.beaver_en: Good. Try sorting out your thoughts while walking.
lines.learner: 그런데 걸으면 후회되는 일이 자꾸 생각나요.
lines.en: But when I walk, things I regret keep coming to mind.
lines.roman: geureonde georeumyeon huhoedoeneun iri jakku saenggangnayo.

lines.beaver_en: What regrets? Would you like to talk about it?
lines.en: I haven't been in touch with my friends back home.

lines.beaver_en: You miss home. Are you feeling homesick?
lines.learner: 네, 고향 생각에 향수를 많이 느껴요.
lines.en: Yes, thinking of home makes me very nostalgic.
lines.roman: ne, gohyang saenggage hyangsureul mani neukkyeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then try contacting your friends first.
lines.learner: 맞아요. 정이 많은 친구들이라 반가워할 거예요.
lines.en: Right. They're warm-hearted, so they'll be glad.
lines.roman: majayo. jeongi maneun chingudeurira bangawohal geoyeyo.

lines.beaver: 음악을 들으며 감상에 젖어 보는 것도 좋아요.
lines.beaver_en: It's also nice to get sentimental listening to music.
lines.beaver_roman: eumageul deureumyeo gamsange jeojeo boneun geotdo joayo.
lines.learner: 고향 노래를 들으면서 감상에 젖어 볼게요.
lines.en: I'll listen to songs from home and get sentimental.
lines.roman: gohyang noraereul deureumyeonseo gamsange jeojeo bolgeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Good. Then your mind will clear up too.
lines.learner: 선배도 바쁘실 때 한번 걸어 보세요.
lines.en: You should try walking too when you're busy.
lines.roman: seonbaedo bappeusil ttae hanbeon georeo boseyo.

lines.beaver_en: Thanks. Let's keep talking often from now on.
lines.learner: 네, 선배 덕분에 마음에 여유가 생겼어요.
lines.en: Yes, thanks to you, I feel more at ease now.
lines.roman: ne, seonbae deokbune maeume yeoyuga saenggyeosseoyo.
